Nanuda vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:8095) on 15 February,
2024

Author: Farjand Ali Bench: Farjand Ali [2024:RJ-JD:8095]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 1154/2024  Nanuda S/o Hing Ji Bhabhar, Aged About 49 Years, R/o  Puniyakudi Gopalpura, Ps Patan, District Baswara.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus  State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hitendra Singh
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 15/02/2024 1.
The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked by way of filing an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. at the instance of accused-petitioner.

The requisite details of the matter are tabulated herein below:
S.No. Particulars of the Case  2. Concerned Police Station Patan  3. District Banswara  4. Offences alleged in the FIR Under Section 376 of the  IPC  5. Offences added, if any - 6. Date of passing of impugned 08.01.2024 order 2.
It is contended on behalf of the accused-petitioner that no case for the alleged offence is made out against the petitioner and his incarceration is not warranted.

There are no factors at play in the case at hand that may work against grant of bail [2024:RJ-JD:8095] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-1154/2024] to the Nanuda vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:8095) on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90004439/
1 accused-petitioner and he has been made an accused based on conjectures and surmises.
3. Contrary to the submissions of learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application and submits that the present case is not fit for enlargement of accused on bail.
4.
I have considered the submissions made by both the parties and have perused the material available on record.

Upon consideration of the submission that the alleged incident of rape occurred on 18.11.2023, but FIR in this case came to be lodged on 13.12.2023 and for which no satisfactory explanation has been furnished and thus, the very possibility of embellishment and concoction cannot be ruled out as well as the submission that her brother was very much known regarding the incident on the very first day, but no legal action was taken, which further persuades this court to extend the benefit of bail to the petitioner.
The victim is a 23 years old married lady.
There is high probability that the trial may take long time to conclude.
In light of these facts and circumstances, it is deemed suitable to grant the benefit of bail to the petitioner in the present matter.

5. Accordingly, the instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner as named in the cause title shall be enlarged on bail provided [2024:RJ-JD:8095] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-1154/2024] he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
(FARJAND ALI),J 82-Pramod/-
